description: Angular component 'PropertyGroupsComponent' for rendering detailed properties and hierarchies of a 'Layer' object in a viewers component of an Android development tool.

classes.name: PropertyGroupsComponent
classes.description: Angular component that displays various grouped properties of a Layer object, including visibility, geometry, buffer info, hierarchy, effects, and input configuration.

methods.name: hasInputChannel
methods.description: Checks if the current Layer item has an input window info channel.

methods.name: getDestinationFrame
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the destination frame of the layer if available.

methods.name: hasIgnoreDestinationFrame
methods.description: Determines if the layer has the ignore destination frame flag set.

methods.name: formatFloat
methods.description: Formats a floating point number to two decimal places.

methods.name: summary
methods.description: Generates a summary array describing visibility reasons and occlusion status of the layer.
